label.description: Text label describing the disclosure. Always escaped.

children.description: Optional summary content. Takes precedence over label.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the summary control.

className.description: Additional classes for the summary element.

textClassName.description: Additional classes for the summary text span.

markerColor.description: USX color utility name for the summary marker, such as primary.

underlineColor.description: USWDS color utility name for the summary underline, such as secondary.

noUnderline.description: Whether to remove the summary underline.

noMarker.description: Whether to remove the native summary marker.

unstyled.description: Render native summary content without USX classes or a text wrapper.
